 WBRE Wilkes-Barre Follow LIHEAP applications now open for 2026-2027
 Adrian Suppes Tue, November 3, 2026 at 12:48 AM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. (WBRE/WYOU) — Applications for the Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) are now open through April 23, 2027, providing families an opportunity for reprieve with heating bills through the cold season.
 Based on household size, income, and fuel type, cash grants can be award from $200 to $1,000 directly to a utility provided or fuel company.
 "Pennsylvanians need to be able to heat their homes and keep themselves and their families warm through the winter, and LIHEAP helps hundreds of thousands of Pennsylvanians each year stay safe and healthy during the coldest months of the year," PA DHS Secretary Dr. Val Arkoosh said. "Anyone who may need help with heating costs and keeping their home safe through this winter should apply for LIHEAP as soon as possible."

 For more information on the program and how to apply, Pennsylvanians can visit the LIHEAP page of pa.gov .
 In case of a heating emergency, crisis grants valued between $25 and $1,000 are also available through an application process.
